summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Donald Stewart (1910–1966), an American actor and singer who settled and worked in the United Kingdom. It covers his training at the American Academy of Dramatic Arts, his Broadway musical appearances, and his move to England, where he performed in revue and became a leading man in 1940s British films. It also notes his later character roles in films and television, and his marriage to actress Renée Houston.
one_line: Biography of Donald Stewart, American actor and singer who became a leading man in 1940s British films and later worked in character roles.
key_facts: Donald Stewart (1910–1966) was an American actor and singer who settled and worked in the United Kingdom.
Donald Stewart trained at the American Academy of Dramatic Arts.
Donald Stewart made several appearances in Broadway musicals before moving to England.
After moving to England, Donald Stewart performed in revue.
Donald Stewart became a leading man in several British films of the 1940s.
Donald Stewart appeared in the film "The Peterville Diamond" (1942).
Donald Stewart appeared in the film "One Exciting Night" (1944).
During the 1950s, Donald Stewart appeared in character roles in films and increasingly on television.
Donald Stewart was married to the actress Renée Houston.
Donald Stewart met Renée Houston while filming "Fine Feathers" (1937).
